=== BEGIN docs/ARCHITECTURE.md ===
   1| ### 4.2 Roles
   2| 
   3| Quarry CMS checks every request against the role of the signed-in user. Each user holds exactly
   4| one role, and the role alone decides which operations the user may perform.
   5| There are four roles: Viewer, Editor, Publisher and Admin.
   6| 
   7| The roles act on seven operations: read pages, edit drafts, upload media, publish pages,
   8| unpublish pages, manage users and change settings. Editing a draft never changes the live version
   9| of a page. Publishing a page makes its draft the live version; unpublishing the page takes it
  10| offline.
  11| 
  12| #### 4.2.1 Permissions
  13| 
  14| - **RL-1.** A Viewer may read pages. A Viewer may perform no other operation.
  15| - **RL-2.** An Editor may read pages, edit drafts and upload media.
  16| - **RL-3.** An Editor may not publish pages and may not unpublish pages.
  17| - **RL-4.** A Publisher may read pages, edit drafts, publish pages and unpublish pages.
  18| - **RL-5.** A Publisher may not upload media.
  19| - **RL-6.** An Admin may perform all seven operations.
  20| - **RL-7.** Only an Admin may manage users and change settings.
  21| 
  22| The roles are not cumulative. A Publisher does not hold every permission of an Editor: RL-5
  23| withholds upload media from the Publisher, so uploads stay with Editors and Admins, who answer for
  24| the files they bring in.
  25| 
  26| #### 4.2.2 Completeness
  27| 
  28| This list is complete. An operation that the list does not grant to a role is denied to that
  29| role, and the server refuses the request before any page or file changes. No other role exists;
  30| the installer creates the first Admin account.
=== END docs/ARCHITECTURE.md ===
